definitions.adx.trend.started.bullish: ADX rose to the trend level (25 by default) with +DI above -DI: a trend is under way, upward.
definitions.adx.trend.started.bearish: ADX rose to the trend level (25 by default) with -DI above +DI: a trend is under way, downward.
definitions.adx.trend.faded: ADX fell below the fade level (20 by default) while trending: price is ranging again.
definitions.adx.di.cross.bullish: +DI crossed above -DI while ADX was at or above its cross level (20 by default).
definitions.adx.di.cross.bearish: -DI crossed above +DI while ADX was at or above its cross level (20 by default).
definitions.atr.regime.expansion: ATR as a percent of close rose into the upper band of its recent range (percentile crossed up through the expansion threshold).
definitions.atr.regime.contraction: ATR as a percent of close fell into the lower band of its recent range (percentile crossed down through the contraction threshold).
definitions.bollinger.break.aboveUpper: Source price crossed from inside/at the band to above the upper band.
definitions.bollinger.break.belowLower: Source price crossed from inside/at the band to below the lower band.
definitions.bollinger.squeeze: Band width fell into the lowest part of its recent range (default: 20th percentile of the last 120 bars): volatility is compressed.
definitions.bollinger.squeeze.released: After a squeeze, band width rose back to the middle of its recent range (default: 50th percentile): volatility is expanding again.
definitions.bollinger.reentry.fromAbove: After a close above the upper band, price closed back inside or at it.
definitions.bollinger.reentry.fromBelow: After a close below the lower band, price closed back inside or at it.
definitions.dss.cross.bullish: The DSS line crossed above its trigger line.
definitions.dss.cross.bearish: The DSS line crossed below its trigger line.
definitions.dss.level.overbought: The DSS line moved above the overbought level (default 80).
definitions.dss.level.oversold: The DSS line moved below the oversold level (default 20).
definitions.dss.exit.overbought: The DSS line fell back below the overbought level (default 80): upward momentum is fading.
definitions.dss.exit.oversold: The DSS line rose back above the oversold level (default 20): downward momentum is fading.
definitions.ema.cross.above: Source price moved from at/below the EMA to above it.
definitions.ema.cross.below: Source price moved from at/above the EMA to below it.
definitions.rsi.exit.overbought: RSI closed at or below the overbought level after being above it.
definitions.rsi.exit.oversold: RSI closed at or above the oversold level after being below it.
definitions.rsi.midline.bullish: RSI closed at or above the midline (50 by default) after being below it.
definitions.rsi.midline.bearish: RSI closed below the midline (50 by default) after being at or above it.
definitions.rsi.divergence.regular.bullish: Price made a lower low while the oscillator made a higher low. Stamped at the bar the later pivot became knowable.
definitions.rsi.divergence.hidden.bullish: Price made a higher low while the oscillator made a lower low. Stamped at the bar the later pivot became knowable.
definitions.rsi.divergence.regular.bearish: Price made a higher high while the oscillator made a lower high. Stamped at the bar the later pivot became knowable.
definitions.rsi.divergence.hidden.bearish: Price made a lower high while the oscillator made a higher high. Stamped at the bar the later pivot became knowable.
definitions.dss.divergence.regular.bullish: Price made a lower low while the oscillator made a higher low. Stamped at the bar the later pivot became knowable.
definitions.dss.divergence.hidden.bullish: Price made a higher low while the oscillator made a lower low. Stamped at the bar the later pivot became knowable.
definitions.dss.divergence.regular.bearish: Price made a higher high while the oscillator made a lower high. Stamped at the bar the later pivot became knowable.
definitions.dss.divergence.hidden.bearish: Price made a lower high while the oscillator made a higher high. Stamped at the bar the later pivot became knowable.
definitions.ema_bullish_unalignment: The upward EMA stack (shorter EMAs above longer ones) lost its order.
definitions.ema_bearish_unalignment: The downward EMA stack (shorter EMAs below longer ones) lost its order.
definitions.ema_bullish_cloud_hit: Price pulled back into the EMA cloud of an upward stack (low pierced EMA10).
definitions.ema_bearish_cloud_hit: Price rose into the EMA cloud of a downward stack (high pierced EMA10).
definitions.ema_bullish_alignment_sustained: The upward EMA stack held its order for the configured duration.
definitions.ema_bearish_alignment_sustained: The downward EMA stack held its order for the configured duration.
definitions.sma.cross.above: Source price moved from at/below the SMA to above it.
definitions.sma.cross.below: Source price moved from at/above the SMA to below it.
definitions.sma.cross.golden: The fast SMA (default 50) moved from at/below the slow SMA (default 200) to above it.
definitions.sma.cross.death: The fast SMA (default 50) moved from at/above the slow SMA (default 200) to below it.
definitions.sma.reclaimed: Price, settled below the SMA, closed above it by at least the ATR buffer on enough consecutive bars (default 2 closes, half an ATR).
definitions.sma.lost: Price, settled above the SMA, closed below it by at least the ATR buffer on enough consecutive bars (default 2 closes, half an ATR).
definitions.swing_high_formed: A swing high was confirmed. The event falls on the confirming bar, a few bars after the high itself.
definitions.swing_low_formed: A swing low was confirmed. The event falls on the confirming bar, a few bars after the low itself.
definitions.higher_high: A new swing high above the previous one was confirmed. The event falls on the confirming bar, a few bars after the high itself.
definitions.lower_high: A new swing high below the previous one was confirmed. The event falls on the confirming bar, a few bars after the high itself.
definitions.higher_low: A new swing low above the previous one was confirmed. The event falls on the confirming bar, a few bars after the low itself.
definitions.lower_low: A new swing low below the previous one was confirmed. The event falls on the confirming bar, a few bars after the low itself.
definitions.swing_high_break: Price broke above a prior swing high.
definitions.swing_low_break: Price broke below a prior swing low.
definitions.swing_high_sweep: Price swept above a prior swing high and quickly reclaimed below it.
definitions.swing_low_sweep: Price swept below a prior swing low and quickly reclaimed above it.
definitions.trendline_breach_bullish: Price wicked through a resistance trendline.
definitions.trendline_breach_bearish: Price wicked through a support trendline.
definitions.trendline_break_bullish: The candle closed above a resistance trendline.
definitions.trendline_break_bearish: The candle closed below a support trendline.
definitions.smc.orderBlock.formed: A new order block zone was confirmed: the move off its swing closed beyond the last opposing swing (a structure break). The event falls on the confirming bar, after the block candle itself.
definitions.smc.orderBlock.tested: Price returned to test an active order block zone (first touch after departing the zone).
definitions.smc.orderBlock.retested: Price returned to tap a still-live (un-mitigated) order block again — a second or later touch. Payload carries touchCount (2, 3, …).
definitions.smc.orderBlock.mitigated: Price passed through an order block, invalidating it.
definitions.smc.orderBlock.breaker: A mitigated order block was reclaimed and now acts as opposite zone.
definitions.smc.fvg.formed: A price imbalance gap was created by a strong impulse move.
definitions.smc.fvg.tested: Price moved into an unfilled fair value gap for the first time.
definitions.smc.fvg.retested: Price exited and then re-entered a still-unfilled fair value gap — a second or later touch. Payload carries touchCount (2, 3, …).
definitions.smc.fvg.partialFill: Price wicked at least halfway (the mitigation threshold) into a fair value gap.
definitions.smc.fvg.filled: Price closed through the far edge of a fair value gap, filling it. A wick through that closes back inside is a test, not a fill.
definitions.smc.bos.bullish: Price broke above a swing high, confirming uptrend continuation.
definitions.smc.bos.bearish: Price broke below a swing low, confirming downtrend continuation.
definitions.smc.choch.bullish: Price broke above a swing high in a downtrend.
definitions.smc.choch.bearish: Price broke below a swing low in an uptrend.
definitions.smc.liquidity.bsl: Equal highs formed a liquidity pool above price: resting stops sit above those highs. The event falls on the bar on which the high that made the pool was confirmed.
definitions.smc.liquidity.ssl: Equal lows formed a liquidity pool below price: resting stops sit below those lows. The event falls on the bar on which the low that made the pool was confirmed.
definitions.smc.liquidity.sweep.bearish: Price traded above a pool of equal highs and closed back below them.
definitions.smc.liquidity.sweep.bullish: Price traded below a pool of equal lows and closed back above them.
definitions.smc.range.discount: Price closed in the lower (discount) half of the dealing range.
definitions.smc.range.premium: Price closed in the upper (premium) half of the dealing range.
definitions.smc.range.equilibrium: Price closed into the equilibrium band around the 50% of the dealing range, from premium or discount — fair value, no edge.
definitions.vwap.cross.above: The candle closed above the VWAP line after the prior candle closed at or below it.
definitions.vwap.cross.below: The candle closed below the VWAP line after the prior candle closed at or above it.
definitions.vwap.band.upper.reached: The candle closed at or above the upper VWAP standard-deviation band — price is stretched rich relative to where volume traded.
definitions.vwap.band.lower.reached: The candle closed at or below the lower VWAP standard-deviation band — price is stretched cheap relative to where volume traded.
definitions.vwap.test.support: Price, trading above the VWAP, pulled back down to the line and then resumed higher — the VWAP held as support. The episode may include a brief pierce below the line that recovered (see the `pierced` payload flag).
definitions.vwap.test.resistance: Price, trading below the VWAP, rallied up to the line and then resumed lower — the VWAP held as resistance. The episode may include a brief pierce above the line that recovered (see the `pierced` payload flag).
definitions.keyLevel.approached: Price closed near the level, from above a support or below a resistance.
definitions.keyLevel.rejected: Price left the level, staying above a support or below a resistance: the level held.
definitions.keyLevel.broken: Price closed beyond the level by the break buffer.
definitions.keyLevel.retested: Price returned to a broken level from the other side.
definitions.keyLevel.flipped: A broken level held from the other side: its role reversed.
definitions.keyLevel.reclaimed: Price closed back through soon after a break: the break failed.
definitions.keyLevel.expired: The level ended, or went untouched for the expiry period.
definitions.cycleFib.levels.formed: A cycle leg completed: both of its pivots are confirmed, so its fib levels now exist.
definitions.cycleFib.retrace.reached.382: Price pulled back to the 38.2% retracement of the current cycle leg.
definitions.cycleFib.retrace.reached.500: Price pulled back to the 50% retracement of the current cycle leg.
definitions.cycleFib.retrace.reached.618: Price pulled back to the 61.8% retracement of the current cycle leg.
definitions.cycleFib.retrace.reached.786: Price pulled back to the 78.6% retracement of the current cycle leg.
definitions.cycleFib.golden_pocket.entered: Price pulled back into the 61.8%–65% retracement zone of the current cycle leg.
definitions.cycleFib.level.held: In an upward cycle leg, price touched a retracement level and closed back above it: the level held as support.
definitions.cycleFib.level.rejected: In a downward cycle leg, price touched a retracement level and closed back below it: the level held as resistance.
definitions.cycleFib.leg.invalidated: Price closed beyond the leg's origin: the full retracement failed and the leg's levels no longer apply.
definitions.cycleFib.extension.reached.1272: Price extended to 127.2% of the current cycle leg, beyond its end.
definitions.cycleFib.extension.reached.1618: Price extended to 161.8% of the current cycle leg, beyond its end.
definitions.cycle.high.provisional: A new provisional cycle high pivot was detected on the detection timeframe.
definitions.cycle.high.confirmed: The active cycle high pivot met confirmation criteria on the detection timeframe.
definitions.cycle.high.developing.33: Pivot confidence reached 33% for the active cycle high.
definitions.cycle.high.developing.66: Pivot confidence reached 66% for the active cycle high.
definitions.cycle.high.developing.100: Pivot confidence reached 100% for the active cycle high.
definitions.cycle.high.superseded: A newer pivot replaced the previous active cycle high.
definitions.cycle.high.higher_high: The latest confirmed cycle high is higher than the previous confirmed cycle high.
definitions.cycle.high.lower_high: The latest confirmed cycle high is lower than the previous confirmed cycle high.
definitions.cycle.high.sweep: Price swept above the most recent confirmed cycle high and reclaimed below it.
definitions.cycle.high.failed: A provisional or developing cycle high was invalidated as price broke above it.
definitions.cycle.high.break: Price closed above the most recent confirmed cycle high. Fires once on the crossing bar. Sibling of cycle.high.sweep (a wick above, then a close back below) and distinct from cycle.high.failed (which only covers provisional/developing pivots).
definitions.cycle.high.window.earliest: Time since the last confirmed cycle high reached the SHORTEST inter-cycle gap on record for this symbol — from here a cycle high is not unprecedented. Weekly only: the stored window's derived earliest edge (daily has no earliest stage).
definitions.cycle.high.window.early: Time since the last confirmed cycle high crossed the 25th percentile of this symbol's inter-cycle gaps — the window OPENS. Weekly and daily: the stored window's opening edge (the same edge the chart draws); hourly: the live state's gap buffer.
definitions.cycle.high.window.mid: Time since the last confirmed cycle high crossed the median (50th percentile) of this symbol's inter-cycle gaps — the centre of the window. Weekly and daily: the stored window's centre.
definitions.cycle.high.window.late: Time since the last confirmed cycle high crossed the 75th percentile of this symbol's inter-cycle gaps — the window has CLOSED and the next cycle high is running overdue. Weekly and daily: the stored window's closing edge.
definitions.cycle.high.window.missed: Time since the last confirmed cycle high passed the LONGEST inter-cycle gap on record for this symbol (the hard max) with no cycle high confirmed — the window is a miss, not a late arrival. Weekly and daily: the stored window's hard-max edge.
definitions.cycle.low.provisional: A new provisional cycle pivot low was detected on the detection timeframe.
definitions.cycle.low.confirmed: The active cycle pivot low met confirmation criteria on the detection timeframe.
definitions.cycle.low.developing.33: Pivot confidence reached 33% for the active cycle pivot low.
definitions.cycle.low.developing.66: Pivot confidence reached 66% for the active cycle pivot low.
definitions.cycle.low.developing.100: Pivot confidence reached 100% for the active cycle pivot low.
definitions.cycle.low.superseded: A newer pivot replaced the previous active cycle pivot low.
definitions.cycle.low.higher_low: The latest confirmed cycle low is higher than the previous confirmed cycle low.
definitions.cycle.low.lower_low: The latest confirmed cycle low is lower than the previous confirmed cycle low.
definitions.cycle.low.sweep: Price swept below the most recent confirmed cycle low and reclaimed above it.
definitions.cycle.low.failed: A provisional or developing cycle pivot low was invalidated as price broke below it.
definitions.cycle.low.break: Price CLOSED below the most recent CONFIRMED cycle low — structure lost. Fires once on the crossing bar. Sibling of cycle.low.sweep (wick below then reclaimed = false break) and distinct from cycle.low.failed (which only covers provisional/developing pivots).
definitions.cycle.low.window.earliest: Time since the last confirmed cycle low reached the shortest inter-cycle gap on record for this symbol. Weekly only: the stored window's derived earliest edge (daily has no earliest stage).
definitions.cycle.low.window.early: Time since the last confirmed cycle low crossed the 25th percentile of this symbol's inter-cycle gaps — the window OPENS. Weekly and daily: the stored window's opening edge (the same edge the chart draws); hourly: the live state's gap buffer.
definitions.cycle.low.window.mid: Time since the last confirmed cycle low crossed the median (50th percentile) of this symbol's inter-cycle gaps — the centre of the window. Weekly and daily: the stored window's centre.
definitions.cycle.low.window.late: Time since the last confirmed cycle low crossed the 75th percentile of this symbol's inter-cycle gaps. Weekly and daily: the stored window's closing edge.
definitions.cycle.low.window.missed: Time since the last confirmed cycle low passed the longest inter-cycle gap on record for this symbol (the hard max) with no newer confirmed cycle low. Weekly and daily: the stored window's hard-max edge.
definitions.onchain.mvrv.deep_value.enter: MVRV (market value ÷ realised value, i.e. the close ÷ the average on-chain cost basis) closed below 1.0, from at or above 1.0 the day before: the close is below the average on-chain cost basis.
definitions.onchain.mvrv.deep_value.exit: MVRV (market value ÷ realised value, i.e. the close ÷ the average on-chain cost basis) closed back at or above 1.0, from below 1.0 the day before.
definitions.onchain.mvrv.overheated.enter: MVRV (market value ÷ realised value, i.e. the close ÷ the average on-chain cost basis) closed above 3.5, from at or below 3.5 the day before: the close is more than 3.5 times the average on-chain cost basis.
definitions.onchain.mvrv.overheated.exit: MVRV (market value ÷ realised value, i.e. the close ÷ the average on-chain cost basis) closed back at or below 3.5, from above 3.5 the day before.
definitions.onchain.supply_in_profit.capitulation.en: The share of supply whose creation price is below the close fell below 50%, from at or above 50% the day before: most coins are held below their creation price.
definitions.onchain.supply_in_profit.capitulation.ex: The share of supply whose creation price is below the close closed back at or above 50%, from below 50% the day before.
definitions.onchain.sth_sopr.reclaim: 7-day short-term-holder SOPR (value spent ÷ value at creation, outputs younger than 150 days, over a week) crossed from below 1 to at or above 1: in aggregate, short-term holders' spent coins moved at or above their creation value.
definitions.onchain.sth_sopr.lose: 7-day short-term-holder SOPR (value spent ÷ value at creation, outputs younger than 150 days, over a week) crossed from at or above 1 to below 1: in aggregate, short-term holders' spent coins moved below their creation value.
definitions.onchain.realised_price.cross.above: The symbol's daily close crossed above the realised price (realised cap ÷ supply: the average on-chain cost basis): on the day before it was below it, on this day at or above it. Compared against the symbol's own stored daily close, decided by the on-chain validator from that close and the level on this day and the day before.
definitions.onchain.realised_price.cross.below: The symbol's daily close crossed below the realised price (realised cap ÷ supply: the average on-chain cost basis): on the day before it was at or above it, on this day below it. Compared against the symbol's own stored daily close, decided by the on-chain validator from that close and the level on this day and the day before.
definitions.onchain.sth_realised_price.cross.above: The symbol's daily close crossed above the STH realised price (the cost basis of outputs younger than 150 days): on the day before it was below it, on this day at or above it. Compared against the symbol's own stored daily close, decided by the on-chain validator from that close and the level on this day and the day before.
definitions.onchain.sth_realised_price.cross.below: The symbol's daily close crossed below the STH realised price (the cost basis of outputs younger than 150 days): on the day before it was at or above it, on this day below it. Compared against the symbol's own stored daily close, decided by the on-chain validator from that close and the level on this day and the day before.
definitions.onchain.lth_realised_price.cross.above: The symbol's daily close crossed above the LTH realised price (the cost basis of outputs 150 days and older): on the day before it was below it, on this day at or above it. Compared against the symbol's own stored daily close, decided by the on-chain validator from that close and the level on this day and the day before.
definitions.onchain.lth_realised_price.cross.below: The symbol's daily close crossed below the LTH realised price (the cost basis of outputs 150 days and older): on the day before it was at or above it, on this day below it. Compared against the symbol's own stored daily close, decided by the on-chain validator from that close and the level on this day and the day before.
definitions.onchain.cohort.addr_1k.supply_30d.rise: The supply held by addresses holding at least 1,000 BTC: its 30-day change crossed above its trailing-365-day 95th percentile (days strictly before this one). An address cohort, not entities: exchange and custodian wallets dominate it, and wallet consolidation moves it with no change of owner.
definitions.onchain.cohort.addr_1k.supply_30d.fall: The supply held by addresses holding at least 1,000 BTC: its 30-day change crossed below its trailing-365-day 5th percentile (days strictly before this one). An address cohort, not entities: exchange and custodian wallets dominate it, and wallet consolidation moves it with no change of owner.
definitions.onchain.cohort.addr_10k.supply_30d.rise: The supply held by addresses holding at least 10,000 BTC: its 30-day change crossed above its trailing-365-day 95th percentile (days strictly before this one). An address cohort, not entities: exchange and custodian wallets dominate it, and wallet consolidation moves it with no change of owner.
definitions.onchain.cohort.addr_10k.supply_30d.fall: The supply held by addresses holding at least 10,000 BTC: its 30-day change crossed below its trailing-365-day 5th percentile (days strictly before this one). An address cohort, not entities: exchange and custodian wallets dominate it, and wallet consolidation moves it with no change of owner.
definitions.onchain.cohort.utxo_1k.supply_30d.rise: The supply held by outputs (UTXOs) of at least 1,000 BTC: its 30-day change crossed above its trailing-365-day 95th percentile (days strictly before this one). An output (UTXO) cohort, not entities: one owner can hold many outputs, and consolidating or splitting them moves it with no change of owner.
definitions.onchain.cohort.utxo_1k.supply_30d.fall: The supply held by outputs (UTXOs) of at least 1,000 BTC: its 30-day change crossed below its trailing-365-day 5th percentile (days strictly before this one). An output (UTXO) cohort, not entities: one owner can hold many outputs, and consolidating or splitting them moves it with no change of owner.
definitions.onchain.dormant.awake.5y: The BTC value of spent outputs at least 5 years old was above its trailing-365-day 99th percentile (days strictly before this one). The amounts are exact chain records; calling the day a spike is statistical. It records that old coins moved, not who moved them or why.
definitions.onchain.dormant.awake.10y: The BTC value of spent outputs at least 10 years old was above its trailing-365-day 99th percentile (days strictly before this one). The amounts are exact chain records; calling the day a spike is statistical. It records that old coins moved, not who moved them or why.
definitions.onchain.cdd.spike: Coin-days destroyed (value × age, over every spent output) was above its trailing-365-day 99th percentile (days strictly before this one). The amounts are exact chain records; calling the day a spike is statistical.
definitions.onchain.whale.large_transfer.spike: The day's activity in transactions whose inputs total at least 1,000 BTC was above its trailing-365-day 99th percentile (days strictly before this one). The amounts are exact chain records; calling the day a spike is statistical. Gross: change and exchange-internal moves count. Transactions, not entities: it says nothing about who sent them.
definitions.onchain.quantum.exposed_share.cross.abov: The share of all bitcoin held in addresses whose public key is already on-chain has risen above a whole percentage point (e.g. 36 %).
definitions.onchain.quantum.exposed_share.cross.belo: The share of all bitcoin held in addresses whose public key is already on-chain has fallen below a whole percentage point (e.g. 36 %).
definitions.onchain.quantum.migration.enter: Exposed bitcoin has fallen at least 3 % in 30 days: coins are leaving addresses with a visible key.
definitions.onchain.quantum.migration.exit: The 30-day fall in exposed bitcoin has eased back above -1.5 %.
definitions.onchain.quantum.old_exposed_moved: At least 1 BTC of pay-to-public-key coins untouched for 10+ years moved today (often Satoshi-era mining rewards).
definitions.onchain.quantum.old_reused_moved: At least 100 BTC of coins untouched for 10+ years moved today from ordinary (hashed) addresses whose public key was already visible because the address had spent before.
definitions.onchain.mining.hash_rate.drawdown.enter: The network's 7-day hash rate is 20% or more below its all-time high.
definitions.onchain.mining.hash_rate.drawdown.exit: Ended: has recovered to within 10% of its high.
definitions.onchain.mining.hash_rate.drop_30d.enter: The 7-day hash rate fell 15% or more over 30 days.
Hash ribbon capitulation: 30-day average hash rate fell below the 60-day average (miners switching off).
definitions.onchain.mining.puell.low.enter: Puell multiple below 0.5: miners' daily issuance revenue is less than half its 1-year average.
definitions.onchain.mining.puell.low.exit: Ended: Puell back to 0.75 or more.
definitions.onchain.mining.puell.high.enter: Puell multiple above 4: miners' daily issuance revenue is over 4x its 1-year average.
definitions.onchain.mining.puell.high.exit: Ended: Puell back to 3.5 or less.
definitions.onchain.mining.fee_share.high.enter: Fees are 10 % or more of miners' block rewards over 7 days (block space in demand).
definitions.onchain.mining.fee_share.low.enter: Fees are under 1 % of miners' block rewards over 7 days.
definitions.onchain.mining.fee_share.low.exit: Ended: fee share back to 1.5 % or more.
definitions.onchain.mining.pool_dominance.top1_30.en: One mining pool found 30 % or more of the last ~week's blocks (1,008).
definitions.onchain.mining.pool_dominance.top1_30.ex: Ended: the largest pool is back under 25 %.
definitions.onchain.mining.pool_dominance.top1_40.en: One mining pool found 40 % or more of the last ~week's blocks.
definitions.onchain.mining.pool_dominance.top1_40.ex: Ended: the largest pool is back under 35 %.
definitions.onchain.mining.pool_dominance.top3_50.en: The three largest pools found half or more of the last ~week's blocks.
definitions.onchain.mining.pool_hhi.above_015.enter: Mining-pool concentration (Herfindahl index of the last ~week's blocks) reached 0.15 or more.
definitions.onchain.mining.pool_hhi.above_018.enter: Mining-pool concentration (Herfindahl index of the last ~week's blocks) reached 0.18 or more — 'highly concentrated' under the 2023 US merger guidelines.
definitions.onchain.mining.hashprice.low_365d: Hashprice (what a petahash of mining earns per day, in USD, from subsidy plus fees) hit its lowest level in a year: miner margins are squeezed.
definitions.onchain.mining.difficulty.retarget: A difficulty adjustment happened (every 2,016 blocks); value = size of the change.
definitions.onchain.mining.difficulty.large_drop: Difficulty fell 5 % or more at a retarget (hash rate left the network).
definitions.onchain.mining.difficulty.large_rise: Difficulty rose 10 % or more at a retarget.
definitions.onchain.fees.consolidation_window.under_: Cheap block space: the median fee has been under 1 sat/vB for 12 blocks in a row (~2 h); a window to consolidate UTXOs or batch payments.
The cheap-fee window closed: the median fee was 1 sat/vB or more for 3 blocks.
Cheap block space: the median fee has been under 2 sat/vB for 12 blocks in a row (~2 h); a window to consolidate UTXOs or batch payments.
The cheap-fee window closed: the median fee was 2 sat/vB or more for 3 blocks.
Cheap block space: the median fee has been under 5 sat/vB for 12 blocks in a row (~2 h); a window to consolidate UTXOs or batch payments.
The cheap-fee window closed: the median fee was 5 sat/vB or more for 3 blocks.
definitions.onchain.fees.spike.start: Fee spike: the 6-block median fee jumped to 4x or more the previous week's median (and at least 2 sat/vB).
definitions.onchain.fees.spike.end: The fee spike faded: below 2x the weekly median for 6 blocks.
definitions.onchain.fees.backlog.start: A sustained backlog: blocks have been full for about a day while even their cheapest transactions paid 3x the recent fee floor and at least 2 sat/vB.
definitions.onchain.fees.backlog.end: The backlog cleared: over the last day, cheap transactions got in again (or blocks were not full) in two of every three blocks.
definitions.onchain.dca.cost_basis.cross.above: Price has risen back above the average purchase price of a regular-purchase cohort (e.g. 'weekly since 2019'): that cohort is back in profit.
definitions.onchain.dca.cost_basis.cross.below: Price has fallen below the average purchase price of a regular-purchase cohort (e.g. 'weekly since 2019'): that cohort is now at a loss.
definitions.onchain.regime.capital_sentiment.changed: BRK's Capital Sentiment phase changed (raw, day to day). Phases place price against four references; see REGIMES.md.
definitions.onchain.regime.capital_sentiment.raging_: Capital Sentiment phase 'Above all four, all-coin cost above trend' has held 3 days running (confirmed): Price is at or above all four references, and the all-coin cost basis is above the 1-year average. References are value-weighted average purchase prices (capitalized prices) of all coins and of short- and long-term holders, plus the 1-year average.
definitions.onchain.regime.capital_sentiment.bull.en: Capital Sentiment phase 'Above all four' has held 3 days running (confirmed): Price is at or above all four references. References are value-weighted average purchase prices (capitalized prices) of all coins and of short- and long-term holders, plus the 1-year average.
definitions.onchain.regime.capital_sentiment.cautiou: Capital Sentiment phase 'Above short-term cost, under trend' has held 3 days running (confirmed): Price is at or above the short-term holders' cost basis but below the 1-year average. References are value-weighted average purchase prices (capitalized prices) of all coins and of short- and long-term holders, plus the 1-year average.
definitions.onchain.regime.capital_sentiment.hopeful: Capital Sentiment phase 'Under short-term cost, above trend' has held 3 days running (confirmed): Price is below the short-term holders' cost basis but at or above the 1-year average. References are value-weighted average purchase prices (capitalized prices) of all coins and of short- and long-term holders, plus the 1-year average.
definitions.onchain.regime.capital_sentiment.early_b: Capital Sentiment phase 'Above short-term cost and trend' has held 3 days running (confirmed): Price is at or above the short-term holders' cost basis and the 1-year average, but below a long-run cost basis. References are value-weighted average purchase prices (capitalized prices) of all coins and of short- and long-term holders, plus the 1-year average.
definitions.onchain.regime.capital_sentiment.weak_bu: Capital Sentiment phase 'Under short-term cost only' has held 3 days running (confirmed): Price is below the short-term holders' cost basis and at or above the other three references. References are value-weighted average purchase prices (capitalized prices) of all coins and of short- and long-term holders, plus the 1-year average.
definitions.onchain.regime.capital_sentiment.limbo.e: Capital Sentiment phase 'Between: two of four above' has held 3 days running (confirmed): Price is below the short-term holders' cost basis, with exactly two of the four references above it. References are value-weighted average purchase prices (capitalized prices) of all coins and of short- and long-term holders, plus the 1-year average.
definitions.onchain.regime.capital_sentiment.deep_be: Capital Sentiment phase 'Below all four, long-term cost above all-coin' has held 3 days running (confirmed): Price is below all four references, and the long-term holders' cost basis is above the all-coin one. References are value-weighted average purchase prices (capitalized prices) of all coins and of short- and long-term holders, plus the 1-year average.
definitions.onchain.regime.capital_sentiment.bear.en: Capital Sentiment phase 'Below all four' has held 3 days running (confirmed): Price is below all four references. References are value-weighted average purchase prices (capitalized prices) of all coins and of short- and long-term holders, plus the 1-year average.
definitions.onchain.regime.capital_sentiment.early_b: Capital Sentiment phase 'Slipping under long-run references' has held 3 days running (confirmed): The short-term holders' cost basis is the highest reference and price is below trend or a long-run cost basis; or price is below three of the four. References are value-weighted average purchase prices (capitalized prices) of all coins and of short- and long-term holders, plus the 1-year average.

definitions.onchain.regime.rarity.full.low.exit: The Rarity Meter (all models) no longer flags spot as unusually low.

definitions.onchain.regime.extreme.capitulation.ente: A rare extreme: a 24-hour realized loss among the rarest 0.1 % in history.
definitions.onchain.regime.extreme.profit_taking.ent: A rare extreme: a 24-hour realized profit among the rarest 0.1 % in history.
definitions.onchain.regime.extreme.peak_regret.enter: A rare extreme: sellers forgoing more value vs their coins' past peaks than on 99.9 % of history.
definitions.onchain.regime.extreme.coins_in_loss.ent: A rare extreme: more coins underwater than at 99.9 % of history.
definitions.onchain.regime.extreme.seller_exhaustion: A rare extreme: realized profit and loss unusually small relative to invested value (rarest 0.1 %).

definitions.onchain.blockspace.stacks.tx_high_90d: Record activity: the most Stacks transactions in a day for at least 90 days.
definitions.cot.leveraged_funds.crowded_long: Leveraged-funds net position crossed into the highest 10% of its 3-year range (index ≥ 90). Reflects the market's CFTC futures positioning (Traders in Financial Futures report, 156-week index), not the instrument's own: CME Bitcoin's fires on BTC/USD, BTCOC/USD. Observable after the CFTC release. Weekly, whatever the strategy timeframe. Leveraged funds are structurally net short on CME BTC (the basis trade), so the index measures range position, not the sign of the net. Unscored context, not a call.
